title: Arshdeep Singh and Actor Samreen Kaur Announce Engagement in New Zealand
excerpt: Kaur shared the proposal photographs on Instagram on November 11 — the same day Arshdeep's Rs 18 crore move to Mumbai Indians headlined the IPL trade window.
body:
• India fast bowler Arshdeep Singh and actor-model Samreen Kaur are engaged. Kaur announced it on Instagram on Wednesday, November 11, with photographs of Arshdeep proposing on one knee in New Zealand.
  • Her caption: "And of all the things life could have given us, I'm the happiest it gave us each other. To a lifetime together. 11.11.2026 (Hi Fiance)."
  • Kaur, from Jammu and Kashmir, was a Femina Miss India 2018 finalist and has acted in the Punjabi film Sardaar Ji 2 (2016) and the Hindi film 83 (2021). The couple made their relationship public on July 26, 2026.
  • No wedding date has been announced. Reports putting a brand name and a Rs 55 lakh price on the ring could not be verified in any coverage of the announcement — every outlet that reported the proposal describes simply a diamond ring.

Arshdeep Singh has had a week. On the same day his move from Punjab Kings to Mumbai Indians headlined the IPL trade window, the India left-arm pacer got engaged to actor-model Samreen Kaur — an announcement Kaur made herself on Instagram on Wednesday, November 11, posting photographs of Arshdeep down on one knee, ring in hand, in New Zealand, where he is touring with India's ODI squad.

"And of all the things life could have given us, I'm the happiest it gave us each other. To a lifetime together. 11.11.2026 (Hi Fiance)," Kaur wrote, in a caption quoted identically by Sportskeeda, Zee News and MensXP. No wedding date has been announced.

Who is Samreen Kaur

Kaur is an actor and model from Jammu and Kashmir. She was a Femina Miss India 2018 finalist representing the state, and studied commerce at Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce in Pune. On screen she has appeared in the Punjabi film Sardaar Ji 2 (2016), the Hindi cricket film 83 (2021) — a fitting credit, given the groom — and the ZEE5 series Nail Polish, alongside music videos with artists including Badshah, Guru Randhawa and Jubin Nautiyal.

""And of all the things life could have given us, I'm the happiest it gave us each other."

A relationship the fans tracked first

The engagement formalises a relationship followers had pieced together over the season. Kaur was repeatedly spotted cheering for Punjab Kings during IPL 2026, and a Snapchat post showing the couple holding hands was matched by fans to her tattoo. Arshdeep ended the speculation himself on July 26, 2026, posting two photographs captioned "My Person." According to MensXP, he has said his wicket-celebration dance this season was dedicated to Kaur.

The cricket context

The proposal lands mid-tour and mid-trade. Arshdeep's switch to Mumbai Indians — with Hardik Pandya moving the other way to Punjab Kings, both at Rs 18 crore — was the biggest trade story of the window; we covered it in Hardik Pandya Traded to Punjab Kings as Arshdeep Singh Joins Mumbai Indians. He is currently in New Zealand with India's ODI squad, which is where the proposal photographs were taken. Between a new franchise, a place in India's touring party in New Zealand and now an engagement, his off-season has been anything but quiet.
